editorial.title_zh: 沙特对中国和土耳其热轧中轻型结构型钢反倾销调查进入登记和抽样阶段
editorial.title_en: Saudi anti-dumping investigation into Chinese and Turkish light and medium hot-rolled sections reaches registration and sampling deadlines
editorial.summary_zh: 沙特外贸总局（GAFT）2026年11月9日发布第15号立案公告（AD-26-3），涉及原产于或出口自中国、土耳其的热轧中轻型结构型钢，包括H、I、W、UB型钢、UPN/UPE槽钢、高度不超过220毫米的等边角钢和宽度不超过300毫米的扁钢。立案援引10个沙特12位参考税号：721621000001、721621000002、721631100001、721631100002、721632100001、721632100002、721633100001、721633100002、721640100001、721640100002。申诉中另外列出的税号未列入立案公告的参考税号清单。倾销调查期为2025年4月1日至2026年3月31日。公告要求利害关系方自公告日起15天内登记，按日历推算为11月24日；已登记境外生产商及出口商的抽样答卷为公告日起21天，按日历推算为11月30日。正式答卷和对申诉的意见自立案通知及非保密申诉文本发出之日起37天内提交，以个案送达通知为准。GAFT公开案件页仍列为调查中，立案公告未规定反倾销税。
editorial.summary_en: Saudi Arabia’s GAFT initiated case AD-26-3 on 9 November 2026 under Notice No. 15. It covers light and medium hot-rolled H, I, W and UB sections, UPN/UPE channels, equal angles up to 220 mm in height, and flat bars up to 300 mm wide, originating in or exported from China or Türkiye. GAFT cited ten Saudi 12-digit tariff lines for reference. The dumping investigation period runs from 1 April 2025 through 31 March 2026. The 15-day interested-party registration and 21-day sampling response periods run from publication, pointing to 24 and 30 November respectively. The standard questionnaire and comments on the complaint are due 37 days after dispatch of the initiation notice and non-confidential complaint. The public case record shows an ongoing investigation. Notice No. 15 imposes no duty.
editorial.impact_zh: 有沙特在途单、长交期订单或新询价时，今天与钢厂、沙特进口商一起按断面形状、尺寸和当地12位税号逐票核对。涉案企业立即向GAFT确认当地提交时点、登记材料及抽样问卷。复核跨期合同中临时或最终反倾销措施的责任分配，现阶段按已实际生效的税费报价。
editorial.impact_en: For Saudi orders, match section geometry, dimensions and Saudi tariff lines with the mill and importer. Affected companies should confirm the local cut-off, registration documents and sampling form with GAFT immediately. Review how contracts allocate any future provisional or definitive anti-dumping duties. Price shipments using currently applicable charges.
editorial.coverage: 核对沙特政府公报第15号全文第3、8、10至12条及GAFT案件页所列立案通知、登记授权和问卷（https://gaft.gov.sa/en/lists/investigations/ad-26-3）。较看板原有立案摘要补齐规格、调查期及不同期限的起算依据。11月24日及30日为按公报日期推算的日历日期，个别当事人的正式送达时间和实际关门时间需向GAFT确认。
editorial.follow_up: 优先核实11月24日登记和11月30日抽样的当地提交时间，并以实际发出通知日期计算正式答卷期限。

editorial.title_zh: 泰国对华预应力混凝土用钢绞线反倾销调查，问卷12月3日截止
editorial.title_en: Thailand sets 3 December questionnaire deadline in anti-dumping investigation on Chinese PC strand
editorial.summary_zh: 泰国商业部外贸厅（DFT）就原产于中国的预应力混凝土用钢绞线（PC Strand，泰国税号7312.10.91）启动反倾销调查，案号AD1057。泰国政府公报2026年10月22日刊登立案公告，10月23日启动。DFT案件页列明，境外生产商及出口商、泰国进口商和买方的问卷截止日为2026年12月3日。DFT公开状态为调查中，暂未列示开始征收反倾销税的日期或企业税率。
editorial.summary_en: Thailand’s DFT opened anti-dumping case AD1057 on prestressed concrete steel strand originating in China, under Thai tariff line 7312.10.91. The Gazette published the notice on 22 October 2026 and the investigation started on 23 October. DFT lists 3 December 2026 as the questionnaire deadline for foreign producers and exporters and for Thai importers and buyers. The case remains under investigation, with no company-specific duty or duty start date listed.
editorial.impact_zh: 优先核对输泰成品钢绞线的产品描述、泰国报关税号及实际生产商。涉及订单时，立即与钢厂和泰国进口商确定答卷分工，核对各自公告、送达记录和附表。DDP或固定到岸总价订单可复核后续税负分配条款，现阶段按已生效税费核算。
editorial.impact_en: Check the product description, Thai declaration code and actual mill for PC strand shipments. The mill and Thai importer should coordinate responses and reconcile their notices, service records and appendices. Review who bears any future duties on DDP or fixed landed-price contracts.
editorial.coverage: 核对DFT案号AD1057、税号、调查状态及按对象列示的问卷期限，查阅泰国政府公报第143卷特别第254ง期第16至18页（https://thaitr.dft.go.th/storage/announcements/Tf3hYUd2au61TKUksgtoDMtSPrOorGgbkVsFbxEP.pdf）。2026年12月3日为案件页的问卷截止日期；企业个别延期或特殊安排以DFT书面答复为准。
editorial.follow_up: 有敞口时，请钢厂及泰国进口商在12月3日前确认问卷正文、附件及递交方式。

editorial.title_zh: 印尼对哈萨克斯坦和白俄罗斯非合金热轧卷反倾销税启动期中复审
editorial.title_en: Indonesia opens interim review of anti-dumping duties on non-alloy hot-rolled coil from Kazakhstan and Belarus
editorial.summary_zh: 印尼反倾销委员会（KADI）2026年11月12日以情势变化为由启动期中复审，涉及白俄罗斯、哈萨克斯坦原产非合金热轧卷，覆盖18个印尼税目，包括7208.10.00、7208.25.00、7208.26.00、7208.27.11/19/91/99、7208.36.00、7208.37.00、7208.38.00、7208.39.10/20/30/40/90及ex 7208.90.10/20/90。KADI公告预计程序最长12个月。既有PMK第103/2024号及其修订第31/2026号的合并国别表对俄罗斯、哈萨克斯坦和白俄罗斯列出5.58%至20%的企业差异税率，其他企业为20%。本次复审覆盖其中两个原产地，KADI公告未调整税率。修订附表中中国企业的适用税率列为20%。
editorial.summary_en: KADI opened a changed-circumstances interim review on 12 November 2026 covering non-alloy hot-rolled coil from Belarus and Kazakhstan across 18 Indonesian tariff lines. KADI expects the investigation to run for no more than 12 months. Regulations PMK 103/2024 and 31/2026 list company-specific rates of 5.58% to 20% in the combined Russia, Kazakhstan and Belarus schedule, with 20% for other companies. The review covers two origins and announces no new rates. The amended schedule lists 20% for Chinese suppliers.
editorial.impact_zh: 中国同类热卷输印尼仍应按现行措施和实际报关产品核算。若复审降低哈萨克斯坦或白俄罗斯货源的到岸税负，相关规格可能对中国热卷报价形成更大竞争。请印尼进口商跟踪复审正式结果，再调整报价。
editorial.impact_en: Continue pricing Chinese coil into Indonesia under the current duty schedule and confirm product coverage with the importer. A reduced duty could make competing Kazakh or Belarusian coil more price-competitive. Track the official outcome before repricing.
editorial.coverage: 核对印尼KADI官方立案稿的阶段、国别和18个税目，并核对财政部PMK第103/2024号及第31/2026号修订附表（https://www.jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/dok/pmk-31-tahun-2026）。KADI新闻稿的调查期终日写作6月31日，属于无效日期，暂按2025年7月至2026年6月记录。未从官方立案材料确认统一应诉截止日。
editorial.follow_up: 如进口商参与案件，向KADI确认正式立案文件、答复时限和调查期终日。报价调整以最终公布的税率为准。

editorial.title_zh: 埃及4月终止对中土冷轧、镀锌及彩涂板反倾销调查，进口保障措施继续执行
editorial.title_en: Egypt ended the Chinese and Turkish CRC, galvanized and pre-painted steel anti-dumping case in April while safeguards continued
editorial.summary_zh: 埃及投资和对外贸易部官方统计确认，第7/2026号公告终止对原产于或出口自中国和土耳其的冷轧卷、镀锌和彩涂钢材的反倾销调查，未征收反倾销税。该公告载于2026年4月1日埃及公报第72号增刊D，11月2日为中文报道刊发日期。独立的第120/2026号保障决定自4月2日起执行。按埃方向WTO的通报，2026年9月14日至2027年9月13日，对符合范围的货物，冷轧为CIF的13%且最低79美元/吨，镀锌为13.5%且最低90美元/吨，彩涂为14%且最低118美元/吨。
editorial.summary_en: Egypt’s Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade confirms that Notice 7/2026 ended the anti-dumping investigation into CRC, galvanized and pre-painted steel from China and Türkiye without duties. The Gazette lists the notice in the 1 April 2026 supplement, while the Chinese report is dated 2 November. Separate safeguard Decision 120/2026 took effect on 2 April. Egypt’s WTO notification sets the 14 September 2026–13 September 2027 rates for covered shipments at 13% of CIF with a USD 79/t minimum for CRC, 13.5% with a USD 90/t minimum for galvanized steel, and 14% with a USD 118/t minimum for pre-painted steel.
editorial.impact_zh: 埃及冷轧、镀锌、彩涂报价仍要计入适用的保障税。请进口商按当地税号、镀层成分及重量和报关日期核对。WTO通报的保障排除项包括符合条件的冷硬卷、铝硅镀层和部分锌铝镁镀层；对中国供货逐票确认产品条件及进口商的证明材料。
editorial.impact_en: Include applicable safeguards in Egyptian CRC, galvanized and pre-painted steel quotes. Ask the importer to verify local tariff lines, coating chemistry and weight, and entry dates. The safeguard notification lists exclusions for qualifying full-hard CRC, aluminium-silicon coatings and certain zinc-aluminium-magnesium coatings. Confirm specifications and supporting documents for each shipment.
editorial.coverage: 核对埃及投资和对外贸易部2026年1至9月报告表43的终止决定与上半年报告所列第7/2026号，公报档案（https://dspace.id.com.eg/items/df3fddec-268b-4673-b1ed-582ae5332df1）确认日期和公告号，单独的公报扫描件需申请访问。保障措施与税率由埃及第120/2026号决定（https://www.mift.gov.eg/legislation/details/157）及埃方WTO通报G/SG/N/10/EGY/12/Suppl.1第5至7节（https://moit.gov.vn/upload/2005517/fck/files/N10EGY12S1__CRC__3ebeb.pdf）核对。反倾销终止的逐项税号未以公报正文复核。
editorial.follow_up: 遇到边界产品时，由进口商提供埃及公报第7/2026号以及第120/2026号适用税号和排除条件的书面核对结果。

editorial.title_zh: 铁矿石期货逼近四年低位，10月中国粗钢产量同比下降1.6%
editorial.title_en: Iron ore futures near four-year lows as Chinese October crude steel output falls 1.6% year on year
editorial.summary_zh: IndexBox援引Trading Economics称，2026年11月17日铁矿石期货接近640元/吨，徘徊在约四年低位。截至11月15日当周全球铁矿石发运量据该机构引用的行业数据增加453万吨至3444万吨。国家统计局另公布，10月中国粗钢产量7083万吨，同比下降1.6%。期货价格和发运量为机构跟踪口径。
editorial.summary_en: IndexBox, citing Trading Economics, reported that iron ore futures traded near CNY 640/t on 17 November 2026, close to a four-year low. Industry data cited by the report put global shipments at 34.44 million tonnes in the week to 15 November, up 4.53 million tonnes. China’s National Bureau of Statistics reported October crude steel output at 70.83 million tonnes, down 1.6% year on year.
editorial.impact_zh: 铁矿下跌提示高炉原料成本面临下行压力。中国热卷和商品级冷轧出口报价先跟踪钢厂最新盘价和交期，再结合焦炭、汇率及海运更新成本；现有实盘以钢厂书面确认价为准。
editorial.impact_en: Lower ore prices point to possible pressure on blast-furnace input costs. For Chinese commodity-grade HRC and CRC offers, check current mill prices and lead times and update the costing for coke, FX and freight. Use confirmed mill quotes for firm offers.
editorial.coverage: 核对IndexBox全文、其引用的Trading Economics原文（https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/iron-ore-cny/news/601823）及国家统计局10月工业增加值表（https://www.stats.gov.cn/zwfwck/sjfb/202611/t20261116_1965842.html）。640元为媒体所述近似价位，未作为特定合约官方结算价；发运量未独立复算。
editorial.follow_up: 关注钢厂热卷盘价、港口库存和焦炭走势，以确认原料价格下跌有没有传导至出口报盘。

triage.reason_zh: Arab News报道与已核验沙特GAFT AD-26-3为同一立案。将公报补证纳入原主条，保留媒体来源链接。
triage.coverage: 核对Arab News原报道及沙特官方公报第15号（https://www.uqn.gov.sa/advertisements/4002359），确认实施方、原产地、产品及立案日期一致。 Arab News正文：https://www.arabnews.com/business/saudi-arabia-opens-anti-dumping-probe-into-steel-imports-from-china-turkiye-3010919
